title: Serano ham canapé
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
pack puff pastry
6
slices serano ham

1
pack puff pastry
6
slices serano ham

Method:-
Roll the pastry 5mm thick.
Cut the pastry into strip 20mm wide.
Lay strips of ham on top of the pastry.
Twist.
Bake at Gas Mark 6 until risen and golden.
Note:-
Chopped fresh rosemary leaves or chopped olives can also be added.
